<text x="90" y="606" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="21" fill="#ECEAE1"><tspan x="90" dy="0">把 6x 拆成两个 3x，拼在 x² 的两边，</tspan><tspan x="90" dy="33.6">缺一个角 3 × 3 = 9；补上它，就是边长 x + 3 的正方形。</tspan></text>
<text x="90" y="750" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="28" fill="#ECEAE1">x² + 6x + 9 = 16 + 9</text>
<text x="90" y="798" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="28" fill="#ECEAE1">(x + 3)² = 25</text>
<text x="90" y="846" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="28" fill="#ECEAE1">x + 3 = ±5</text>
<text x="90" y="894" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="#F2D67A">x₁ = 2，x₂ = -8</text>

<g id="layer5" inkscape:groupmode="layer" inkscape:label="一般推导">
<text x="830" y="210" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" fill="#F2D67A">ax² + bx + c = 0（a ≠ 0）</text>
<text x="830" y="270" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#ECEAE1">两边除以 a：　x² + (b/a)x = −c/a</text>
<text x="830" y="316" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#ECEAE1">加上一次项系数一半的平方：</text>
<text x="830" y="362" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#ECEAE1">　x² + (b/a)x + (b/2a)² = (b/2a)² − c/a</text>
<text x="830" y="408" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#ECEAE1">　(x + b/2a)² = (b² − 4ac) / 4a²</text>

<text x="830" y="650" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#ECEAE1">判别式 Δ = b² − 4ac</text>

<text x="990" y="700" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#ECEAE1">两个不相等的实数根</text>
<text x="850" y="744" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#F0A8A2">Δ = 0</text>
<text x="990" y="744" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#ECEAE1">两个相等的实数根</text>
<text x="850" y="788" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#F0A8A2">Δ < 0</text>
<text x="990" y="788" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#ECEAE1">没有实数根</text>
<text x="830" y="860" font-family="'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#ECEAE1" opacity="0.9">例中 Δ = 6² − 4 × 1 × (−16) = 100，所以有两个不相等的实数根。</text>
